data.name: Powerful Sneak*
data.description: Whenever you take a full-attack action, you can take a -2 penalty on all attack rolls until the start of your next turn. If you do, you can reroll any sneak attack damage dice that result in 1s. You can reroll multiple dice, but you can't reroll any individual die more than once per attack.
